low_denominator: Epi_support < 0.10 including zero; retain all in primary stats
discordance: within frozen query per section, linear Q75/Q25 inclusive in opposite directions for MP10 and raw support; ties retained
non_epi_diagnostic: c2l Epi fraction < 0.10 and dominant broad lineage other than Epithelial
descriptive_top: raw support >= within-section frozen query Q95, ties retained
paired_pseudo_features: identical detected intersection of paired medium and low queries before reference scaling/PCA
